title: Dragon
creator: CrossFit
description: Run 5 km, take 4 minutes to find a 4-rep-max deadlift, run another 5 km, then 4 minutes for a 4-rep-max push jerk. Honours U.S. Army Capt. Nicholas Rozanski, Ohio National Guard, killed in Faryab Province, Afghanistan, in 2012. Score is time plus the two loads; have bars loaded and ready before you start.
